main_result: For symmetric A0 and arbitrary symmetric added E with delta_q=s_{q+1}(E), final A=A0+E, and any invertible r-coordinate original physical pivot with Schur complement S, s_k(S)>=max(0,s_{q+r+k}(A0)-delta_q). The q leading added eigenmodes may be arbitrarily large, signed and oriented; the remaining full-rank tail is charged only by delta_q. Positive and negative threshold counts separately lose at most q+r after the same threshold shift.
